title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
A generative AI system created fake pornographic videos of Dutch public figures, including politicians, athletes, and entertainers, and distributed them on a platform with millions of monthly visitors. The deepfake videos were generated and uploaded by users who remained anonymous to avoid prosecution, receiving payment based on view counts.

The deployment failure was the absence of content moderation at the hosting platform. The system accepted and distributed material that is criminal under revenge porn laws, requiring only that users remained unidentified to continue operating. Detection would have required either automated content scanning at upload or human review of flagged material before distribution.

It is not established how the deepfake videos were originally created, what specific generative model was used, or whether the hosting platform was designed specifically for this purpose or adapted for it.

summary:
Several Dutch female celebrities are considering legal action after discovering themselves in fake pornographic videos on an online platform that receives 13 million monthly visitors. The videos feature manipulated content of Dutch artists, television presenters, Olympic athletes, government officials, mayors, and members of the royal family. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and urged victims to file reports. Managers and representatives of various victims confirmed to NOS that they have filed complaints or are considering legal steps to address the situation.

Deepfake pornography falls under revenge porn laws and is therefore criminal. Users who upload material are advised to remain anonymous to avoid prosecution and receive payment based on video views. Legal experts warn that without government intervention, more fake videos will appear. Victims have several options including filing reports with police, launching mass lawsuits, filing complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. A previous case involving television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma resulted in a 39-year-old man from Amersfoort receiving a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
